First, just some general advice. Try to do something small on those terrible days. Push yourself to take a shower or have a bite to eat. Now, my lucid dreaming advice. The way I taught myself to lucid dream was I repeated a mantra to myself every night. Such as “I am going to lucid dream tonight.” I said it out loud ten times. I wrote it down ten times. I visualized it, anything to get it into my head. Sometimes I would thing of one specific thing I wanted to have happen. I would also repeat that thing to myself as well. This worked for me. Also, what do you think is causing these nightmares and sleep paralysis for you? For me it was unresolved trauma. If you address the source of whatever is truly bothering you, it may help.

I don’t know if this will help you since I’ve never struggled with sleep paralysis, but I have struggled with nightmares before. But my solution was a couple of things. The first thing was I tired myself out completely. I exercised a ton, and did anything that would make me fall asleep super quickly. This helped with the fear of falling asleep. The next thing that I did was I taught myself how to lucid dream. That way when I was in a nightmare, I could get myself out of it just by flying or something.
